title: test(app-shell): pin the invite outcome toast and the copy-invite-link dialog on Setup → Invitations

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSfbLeHh7TGZNuKPH73JdBz)_

Fixes #27797
Refs #27521 (row 6)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只新增一个测试文件，在真实的 Setup → Invitations 列表页上钉住两件事：没配邮件时邀请提示不说「已发送」，以及「Copy Invite Link」能把接受链接复制到剪贴板。没有改任何产品代码。
- 为什么改：服务端修复（#27843，PR #27902）已在 main 上；按裁决 E，本卡只做现场复测和一个 ObjectView 钉子。现场复测确认修复已经到达控制台，管理员在无邮件部署上不再被告知「已发送」，也能把链接手动交给受邀人。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，只加测试（私有包 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的 `src` 下，不随任何包发布）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteOutcome-27797.test.tsx`（唯一文件；先看 fixture 里的 `FEATURES` 与 `copy_invitation_link` 的 `visible`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteOutcome-27797.test.tsx`，预期 4 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One new pin, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteOutcome-27797.test.tsx`, beside `ObjectView.inviteFeedback-11817.test.tsx`. It mounts the real `ObjectView` over `sys_invitation` as a stock boot serves it, with the real action runner, console action runtime, param dialog, result dialog and toaster (sonner not mocked):

- `link_only` invite answer: the toast is the declared "Invitation created for ada@example.com. Mail is not configured on this server, so no email went out. Use Copy Invite Link on the invitation to share it." and no "Invitation sent" text appears.
- Control, `sent` answer: "Invitation sent to ada@example.com", and no "no email went out" text.
- A pending row's menu offers Copy Invite Link. Its click posts to `/api/v1/actions/sys_invitation/copy_invitation_link` naming the row id. The result dialog titled "Invite link" shows the answered `acceptUrl` as text, and its copy button writes exactly that URL to the clipboard.
- Control: an accepted row's menu offers Resend Invitation and no Copy Invite Link.

No ui code changed. Per ruling E (comment 6512831254), the server carries the fix (`outcomeMessages`, and a `type: 'script'` action answering into a `resultDialog` with `format: 'text'`). The live re-measure below shows that fix reaching the console unchanged, so no renderer change was needed.

## Tests

- Pin: 4/4 passed at `43ba24a6` (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteOutcome-27797.test.tsx`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT command-exit 0).
- The first run failed 3 of 4 when the fixture's features omitted `cloudManaged`. Every served invite predicate reads `features.cloudManaged != true`, an absent key fails the predicate closed, and a stock boot serves `cloudManaged: false`. The fixture now carries the served value, with a comment saying why.
- No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour, since it only adds a test.

## Acceptance notes

- Live re-measure, stock `examples/app-showcase` (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, seeded admin, desktop 1440×900, Chromium), `origin/main` `10fc9bf1`, full workspace build plus console build from this tree:
  - **No mail transport** (default `log`): the invite door answers `outcome: "link_only"`. Toast: "Invitation created for ada.nomail@example.com. Mail is not configured on this server, so no email went out. Use Copy Invite Link on the invitation to share it." Resend toast: "Invitation renewed for … no email went out …". Row menu: Cancel Invitation, Resend Invitation, Copy Invite Link. The detail drawer's record header shows Copy Invite Link. The copy dialog shows `http://localhost:38797/_console/accept-invitation/ID`, the copy button puts that same string on the clipboard, and the URL answers 200 `text/html` (the accept page under the console mount).
  - **Live transport**: `OS_EMAIL_PROVIDER=smtp` against a local SMTP sink. The door answers `outcome: "sent"`, and the toast reads "Invitation sent to grace.mail@example.com". The accept URL in the delivered mail (quoted-printable decoded) equals the copy dialog's URL byte for byte.
- Out of scope, for the seat (class a, reach measured in the console): the result dialog's copy button (`CopyButton` in `ActionResultDialog.tsx`, used by the `text` / `secret` / `qrcode` / `code-list` / `json` formats) is icon-only and has no accessible name. In the live dialog its `aria-label` and text are both empty, so a screen reader announces an unnamed button. This affects every `resultDialog`, not only invitations. Dedupe words: result dialog copy button accessible name, CopyButton aria-label, resultDialog copy icon.
- `skip-changeset` is right for this diff: it is tests only, in `@object-ui/app-shell` (`"private": true`, `files` lists `dist`, and the built `dist` has 0 hits for the test against a positive control of 8 for `ActionResultDialog`). The seat applies the label after its own check.
